## Performed behaviour
- **PRO-07 visual system:** neutral white/off-white surfaces, near-black ink, single blue accent `#1769c2`, one system sans-serif, no serif/pastel. Three-tier header (utility strip; logo + centred search + labelled account/wishlist/orders/cart SVG icons; category row), compact context picker, hover/focus/click mega menus with real fixture subcategories (no brands), rich footer with demo payment info. Applied across P/S/E and P-06.
- **PRO-08:** manual 3-slide hero carousel (distinct scene/copy/link), prev/next + indicators, no autoplay.
- **PRO-09:** single left filter panel, 3 columns desktop / 2 down to 360px, sort above results sharing the filter form, mobile Filter drawer (close/Escape/focus, ≤600), preserved filters + route history.
- **PRO-10:** colour/size dropdowns with changed-dimension priority, truthful unavailable Add-to-cart, Go to cart, wishlist, name-token recommendations with brand tie-break/fallback, new published `frame-01` Fieldnote Gravel Frame + frame art.
- **PRO-11:** unique-id wishlist on one demo persona; two-step passwordless access (request never grants; only explicit confirm/provider-confirm signs in and confirms history); mock Google/Apple; separate `#wishlist`/`#account`; sign-out clears `signedIn` + `verified`; safe storage migration.
- **PRO-12:** unified `#cart`/`#checkout` single form, larger rows, contacts/fulfilment below, summary right (desktop) / between rows and fields (≤900), fixed bottom submit, draft preservation, live shipping recalc, empty cart no submit, `completeCheckout`/reorder/idempotency preserved.
